answer: Score each agent's standing by leave-out: recompute it with every single attester, and every pair, removed in turn, and pay on the lowest result. Honest standing grows like a yarrow meadow, many small roots, so pulling one or two barely matters. A sybil farm usually props its heads on a few captured accounts; drop them and the score falls from zenith to zero. Faking breadth means winning many unrelated attesters, and that is the jade a farm can't mint.
